description: Preserve the Release 1237 CROSS grammar while routing the exact new beaver dam through canonical CROSS object dispatch.

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE V-VETERAN-CROSS ()
    <VETERAN-ENSURE>
    <COND (<NOT <VETERAN-GET ,VETERAN-SLOT-ACTIVE>>
           <TELL "No veteran expedition is active." CR>)
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE V-VETERAN-CROSS ()
    <VETERAN-ENSURE>
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,BACKCOUNTRY-BEAVER-DAM>
           <PERFORM ,V?CROSS ,PRSO>)
          (<NOT <VETERAN-GET ,VETERAN-SLOT-ACTIVE>>
           <TELL "No veteran expedition is active." CR>)
